cards.name: Spatial Merging
cards.oracleText: When you encounter Spatial Merging, reveal cards from the top of your planar deck until you reveal two plane cards. Simultaneously planeswalk to both of them. Put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your planar deck in any order.

cards.name: Meltdown
cards.oracleText: Destroy each artifact with mana value X or less.

cards.name: Gravebind
cards.oracleText:
Target creature can't be regenerated this turn.
Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
